title: Vividly Sour Yunnan Soya Bean Congee
description: A traditional Yunnan dish featuring soya bean and coconut cream, this congee is a sour and flaky solo dinner option that is high in protein.
instructions: Rinse the dried soya beans and soak them in water for at least 4 hours.
Drain and rinse the soya beans, then combine them with rice, water, and salt in a large pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 hour.
Stir in the coconut cream and sour plum paste.
Add the sliced ginger to the pot and continue to simmer for another 30 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the congee hot, garnished with chopped scallions.
Crack some coconut cream on top of the congee before serving.
Let it cool for a few minutes before eating.
